messages.subject: Global Mining Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Quinn,

I am reaching out for consideration for confidential senior leadership mandates across global mining, natural resources, energy and infrastructure.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, executive communications and high-stakes stakeholder coordination within a major gold-mining operation.

My strongest value sits where mining strategy depends on institutional trust, regulatory discipline, responsible development and coordinated execution across operational, corporate, technical, community and public-sector stakeholders.

Your leadership of Odgers' Global Mining Practice and Industrial Practice makes this a focused introduction. I am open to Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments, including expatriate and rotational roles across the GCC, Africa, the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

My executive CV is attached for review. I would value consideration for current or future mandates spanning ESG and Sustainability, Government Relations, External and Corporate Affairs, Stakeholder Relations, Strategic Partnerships, Country Leadership, Mining and Energy.

Best regards,

Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
